rules.content:
/*
darkleakmarket ransomware
*/

rule darkleakmarket_Ransomnote
{
    meta:
        author = "ransomware.live"
        family = "ransomware.darkleakmarket"
        description = "Detects darkleakmarket ransomware ransom note or artifact"
        date = "2026-05-04"
        severity = 7
        score = 70

    strings:
        $name1 = "darkleakmarket" ascii nocase
        $name2 = "DARKLEAKMARKET" ascii
        $onion  = "darkleakmarket.onion" ascii nocase

    condition:
        any of them
}
